disposition_reason: The study measures Cd, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb and Zn in mosses and in unwashed European blueberry (Vaccinium myrtillus) LEAVES used as bioindicators, plus ribwort plantain and dandelion leaves; no berries or other foods were analyzed.
disposition_locator: Sampling and Chemical analysis sections, p. 3-4; Table 2, p. 7

study.design: biomonitoring transect of mosses and European blueberry leaves along an altitude gradient
study.origin: Jaworzyna Krynicka, Sadecki Beskids, southern Poland, forest polygons A-E (700-1,100 m) plus grassland/arable polygons F-G (500-600 m)
study.method: unwashed plant material dried 40 C, microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-MS (commercial laboratory)
lod: µg/g dry matter: Cd 0.01, Cr 0.1, Cu 0.01, Ni 0.1, Pb 0.01, Zn 0.1
study.qa: STD CDV-1 and STD V16 reference materials used; results not reported

unresolved: The manifest describes the matrix as European blueberries; the paper analyzed blueberry leaves (Sampling, p. 3), not fruit, so no berry findings exist.
Leaf and moss means by altitude (Table 2) are biomonitoring data and are not recorded as food findings.
